title: PayCall Hotline Data
description: Official customer-service and government hotline numbers in the U.S., Canada, the UK and Australia, each with the organisation's own source URL and check date; whether the line answered calls through PayCall from abroad; phone-menu routes tested with real calls; and hold times measured on real calls (range and median). Method: https://pay-call.com/hotline-data. Live API: https://pay-call.com/hotlines.json
